summary:
Turn 24 delivered the map handoff for the confirmed stable-store defect, keeping the understanding layer aligned with the second confirmed claim.

State on entry. Claim C2-durable-record-preserves-written-fields is confirmed in scope (artifact efdc2a8c04df42ad93bf7d4f66be08ec, executed as 310d33db15394688a5ee2d808ed3a4a3, outcome violated, oracle correspondence reviewed with no issue found), alongside the four-artifact recovery claim C1 with three of its checks confirmed. The map still described the recorder only as an open detail, so it needed the handoff.

Map update (accepted base version 5, three clarified objects). Behavior B15-durable-record's first branch now records the confirmed observation: the header writes bal at [0:4) and then vbal into the same bytes, Status at byte [4] and Seq at [5:9), and a record produced with distinct field values carries vbal at offset 0 with no bal value at all; its unknown is narrowed to the absence of any reader. Fact F7-durable-bytes gained the observed header in its representation (04030201|03|100f0e0d|deps) and its unknown now states the confirmed loss of bal plus the residual external-reader question. core_overview's durable open detail was rewritten as a sourced statement of the collision with the confirmed in-scope observation and the bounded consequence (no reader in the snapshot, durable=false in the launched configuration).

Each change carries a map_changes entry with sources and a preserves explanation, so no requirement, binding, edge, identity or fact context moved; the claim and its check remain the home for the verdict. The next discriminator is recorded in feedback: whether any external tool or later revision reads the stable store and expects particular offsets (no reader exists in the snapshot), whether repeated records or other fields collide, and the still-open question of whether the confirmed recovery disagreement is observable in applied state. No earlier result, premise or observation was weakened.
